content: LLM extraction eval: build a versioned golden dataset (representative inputs + expected structured output). Three tiers: offline regression run before every release vs historical baseline; CI/CD gate on every PR that touches prompt/model/schema (tens-to-low-hundreds subset); production sampling + drift alerts. Grow full set to 100-1000 items. Close the loop: every production failure / low-confidence correction becomes a new test case. Fixed dataset + fixed evaluators + fixed thresholds. Field-level precision/recall on {object, service, work, period, counts} beats a single accuracy number.
